facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Historical program targeted early-stage deep-tech startups.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 US / Europe / Israel 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；AI / AI-native；B2B / Enterprise SaaS；阶段以 Seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
facts_raw.Notes: Critical correction: Intel Ignite official contact page states the Deep Tech accelerator program is no longer active. Keep only as historical/archived opportunity.

facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Historical program targeted early-stage deep-tech startups.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for US / Europe / Israel.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; AI / AI-native; B2B / Enterprise SaaS; primarily at the Seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: Critical correction: Intel Ignite official contact page states the Deep Tech accelerator program is no longer active. Keep only as historical/archived opportunity.
